style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Bauble Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a sophisticated twist to your festive decorating with this 183cm artificial bauble garland in green & bronze—where classic meets contemporary in the most stunning way. Featuring an elegant mix of rich green and warm bronze baubles in varying textures and finishes, this garland delivers subtle sparkle and refined festive charm. Perfect for draping over mantels, winding along stair railings, framing entryways, or elevating your dining table décor, this garland is as versatile as it is eye-catching. Its rich colour palette makes it ideal for traditional, rustic, or luxe Christmas themes. Whether you re going for warm and cosy or sleek and chic, this garland adds a touch of festive magic with a modern edge. .Garland Length: L183cm. .Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
